chapter: King Oliver, own trio and Kirby
title: Meeting Erskine Hawkins in Birmingham
summary: Moore met Hawkins in Birmingham before he left there.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Did you get a chance to meet at that time Benny? You say you played "Tuxedo Junction." How about Erskine Hawkins, or even Glenn Miller?
I met Erskine Hawkins in Birmingham, Alabama.
So you met Erskine before he left Birmingham.
I see. He was studying the trumpet in school at that time, I understand.

This was also at the time that he was with the Collegians. Or was this before he joined that? At the time in Birmingham he would have been much younger. That was before he teamed up with the Collegians...
